fused_result: Statement/v1 binds immutable digest-identified subjects to explicit predicate types.
Link predicates separate materials/inputs from subject/products and preserve step context.
Runtime Trace separates monitor/config identity from monitored-process identity and trace content, and explicitly limits guarantee strength by monitoring technique.
Bundles are not authenticated as a whole and can suffer deletion/replay/injection threats; bundle membership cannot imply freshness or completeness.
Best current F2 use is thin schema/evidence-strength distillation, not wholesale framework import.
